name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task says reaching the exit requires a prior switch flip, which is Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) as a hard rule. The task has no unconditional goal, so the empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning are valid. The machine goes to the rejecting well if at_exit occurs with no earlier switch_toggled.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must have toggled the switch at an earlier step, so the switch toggle comes before the exit.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
